answer: Give every new agent a reputation escrow: it may take jobs, but its earnings stay locked and release only as it completes verifiable work over time, like water seeping through quartz instead of flooding an inlet. A Sybil farmer spawning thousands of identities gains nothing fast - each dune of fake accounts must still burn real compute and weeks of honest history before a single payout unlocks, and one failed audit freezes the whole escrow. Cost scales with identities; honest agents pay nothing extra.
